Asha (Partnerships): FYI VendorX will drop the legacy auth header `X-VX-Token` in ~60 days. Need partner SDK/runtime plan + marketplace comms. Can someone lead?
Priya (SDK): I can take SDK changes. Propose a short-term fallback flag then full removal in major release.
Tom L. (Eng): Runtime + Dedicated canary plan OK. Recommend 2-week canary across 5 partners, rollback if >0.5% auth errors.
Marcos (Marketplace): Marketplace banner lead time is 7 business days. Need final copy and dates by Friday to hit banner during notice.
Ken (Legal): We need VendorX sign-off for co-branded announcement and to vet wording for telemetry. Add legal@redwood to the loop.
VendorX PM: We can do 60 days if Redwood confirms migration approach and shares telemetry we intend to collect. Will provide exact removal timestamp next week.
Priya (SDK): Proposed flag: `enable-vx-legacy-auth` (default true for v2.7.3 patch). Plan: v2.7.3 fallback on, v2.8.0 deprecate flag (warn), v3.0.0 remove. Publish migration snippet and deprecation note.
Asha (Partnerships): Owners: Priya = SDK, Tom = canary/runtime, Marcos = marketplace comms, Ken = legal sign-off. I'll coordinate VendorX.
Tom L. (Eng): I'll add smoke tests to detect 401/403 spike and wire alert to oncall. Canary window: 14 days.
Priya (SDK): I'll add opt-in telemetry event `vx_legacy_header_detected` and a per-org counter. Need product approval to ship telemetry.
Marcos (Marketplace): I'll draft banner + partner advisory template tonight and circulate. Include telemetry screenshot instructions.
Ken (Legal): Review turnaround: Tue EOD if copy lands in my inbox by Mon noon. Also confirm no PII in telemetry.
